generate_fake_atomic_structures: generate fake atomic structures with LJ-like energies and repulsive forces using a FakeDatasetConfig
create_single_fake_dataset: create a single fake ASE database from a FakeDatasetConfig and write it to disk
create_all_benchmark_datasets: generate all 5 UMA benchmark datasets with production-like system sizes into a temp directory
configure_fake_dataset_split: configure a FakeDatasetConfig with normalization constants and split metadata for a dataset split
compute_lennard_jones_energy: compute the Lennard-Jones potential energy for an ASE Atoms object with configurable epsilon and sigma
